additions.site_identity_review: The Atlas site 'Digital Realty (iColo) Nairobi Karen Campus' (vcc-site-2375f74ae82f8b71b33b) holds one project, curated:icolo-nairobi-karen-campus:nbo2 (Digital Realty Nairobi Two, operational 7 September 2026), and its campus locator is described in the base as 'the operator-linked marker for the named NBO1 facility, used as the parent locator for the Nairobi Karen campus that contains NBO1 and NBO2'. Digital Realty's release of 7 September 2026 says NBO2 was 'Built alongside Nairobi One (NBO1)' and expands 'its Nairobi campus'; its NBO1 and NBO2 pages give the same campus address (Langata S Rd & LRC Rd, Nairobi) and the Nairobi metro page lists exactly these two data centres there. The two buildings stay separate projects with their own sizes (NBO1 15,500 ft2, NBO2 12,000 ft2).

status.summary: Digital Realty's NBO1 facility page, in its version modified on 16 September 2026, presents NBO1 at Langata S Rd & LRC Rd, Nairobi as a colocation data centre offering single cabinets to private data center suites, with a total building size of 15,500 ft2 (1,450 m2), 2N UPS, N+2 cooling, Tier III, PCI-DSS and ISO 27001, 24x7 onsite security, and invites visitors to talk specs and availability. Digital Realty's release of 7 September 2026 places NBO1 on the live Nairobi campus beside the newly opened NBO2, where customers connect to more than 100 networks, two internet exchange points and a satellite teleport. This records NBO1 as an operating commercial colocation data centre on 16 September 2026, the modification day of the captured version (bounded by the 10 June 2026 archive copy of the earlier version and the 3 October 2026 archived sitemap). It is not an opening date; the building size is a specification, not IT load or capacity in service.
